trainer.svb_arena1_junior.defeated: Well sailed. Karl is waiting by the lantern.
trainer.svb_arena1_junior.intro: The ferry only leaves once you've beaten me!
trainer.svb_arena1_junior.name: Ferryman Ole
trainer.svb_arena2_junior.defeated: You made it. Sanne is by the fire.
trainer.svb_arena2_junior.intro: Nobody goes down to the bonfire without a battle. Beach rules!
trainer.svb_arena2_junior.name: Lifeguard Mikkel
trainer.svb_arena3_junior.defeated: Nicely tacked. Hanne is down at the slipway.
trainer.svb_arena3_junior.intro: The wind is coming in off the sound. Ready to battle?
trainer.svb_arena3_junior.name: Sailor Freja
trainer.svb_arena4_junior.defeated: Course is set. Go on up to the skipper.
trainer.svb_arena4_junior.intro: The skipper is on the bridge. First you get past the mate!
trainer.svb_arena4_junior.name: Mate Ida
trainer.svb_arena5_junior.defeated: Neatly done. Ebba waits in the courtyard.
trainer.svb_arena5_junior.intro: The hedges need trimming, but first you do!
trainer.svb_arena5_junior.name: Castle Gardener Poul
trainer.svb_arena6_junior.defeated: You split me in two. Torben is up at the mill.
trainer.svb_arena6_junior.intro: These hills are full of stones. I've collected the best!
trainer.svb_arena6_junior.name: Stonemason Lise
trainer.svb_arena7_junior.defeated: Good tracking. Agnete is waiting by the lake.
trainer.svb_arena7_junior.intro: Quiet now, or you'll scare the animals. Let's battle instead.
trainer.svb_arena7_junior.name: Hunter Anders
trainer.svb_arena8_junior.defeated: You dug deeper. Sigrun waits at the dig.
trainer.svb_arena8_junior.intro: Every spadeful may hide a gold figure. And every battle a win!
trainer.svb_arena8_junior.name: Digger Rune
trainer.svb_leader_fire.defeated: You put out my flames. The Bonfire badge is yours.
trainer.svb_leader_fire.intro: The bonfire on the beach burns all night. Can your team take the heat?
trainer.svb_leader_fire.name: Bonfire Keeper Sanne
trainer.svb_leader_folk.defeated: That was royal. The Castle badge is yours.
trainer.svb_leader_folk.intro: The castle has seen sea heroes and kings. Now it will see you try.
trainer.svb_leader_folk.name: Castle Steward Ebba
trainer.svb_leader_grove.defeated: The forest bows to you. The Forest badge is yours.
trainer.svb_leader_grove.intro: The estate's woods are old and they remember everything. Show me what you've learned.
trainer.svb_leader_grove.name: Head Forester Agnete
trainer.svb_leader_mixed.defeated: You're the greatest treasure I've found. The Gold badge is yours, champion!
trainer.svb_leader_mixed.intro: Gudme's gold lay in the ground for 1,500 years. My team has waited just as long for you.
trainer.svb_leader_mixed.name: Archaeologist Sigrun
trainer.svb_leader_spirit.defeated: You found your way in the dark. The Lantern badge is yours.
trainer.svb_leader_spirit.intro: When the lantern is lit on the quay, the harbour's spirits wake. Let's see if you dare.
trainer.svb_leader_spirit.name: Harbour Master Karl
trainer.svb_leader_stone.defeated: You're harder than granite. The Mill badge is yours.
trainer.svb_leader_stone.intro: The millstones have ground grain for a hundred years. Now they grind you.
trainer.svb_leader_stone.name: Miller Torben
trainer.svb_leader_storm.defeated: You steered safely through the storm. The Skipper badge is yours.
trainer.svb_leader_storm.intro: Troense has sent ships out in every kind of weather. Today the storm is me.
trainer.svb_leader_storm.name: Skipper Jens
trainer.svb_leader_water.defeated: You're seaworthy. The Island badge is yours.
trainer.svb_leader_water.intro: I've built boats on Thurø all my life. Let's see if your team holds water.
trainer.svb_leader_water.name: Shipwright Hanne
trainer.svb_route1_a.intro: The quay is where I work. Now it's where we battle!
trainer.svb_route1_a.name: Dock worker Carl
trainer.svb_route1_b.defeated: You washed me out like a wave.
trainer.svb_route1_b.intro: Sand between my toes and a battle at hand!
trainer.svb_route1_b.name: Beachgoer Sebastian
trainer.svb_route10_a.defeated: You pulled me up by the roots.
trainer.svb_route10_a.intro: The estate garden is my pride. So is my team!
trainer.svb_route10_a.name: Estate gardener Viggo
trainer.svb_route10_b.defeated: You pulled me up by the roots.
trainer.svb_route10_b.intro: The estate garden is my pride. So is my team!
trainer.svb_route10_b.name: Estate gardener Malthe
trainer.svb_route10_c.intro: The mill turns, and so do I. Bring it on!
trainer.svb_route10_c.name: Miller's apprentice Christian
trainer.svb_route11_a.defeated: The dog took it better than I did.
trainer.svb_route11_a.intro: We walk every day. Today we battle!
trainer.svb_route11_a.name: Dog walker Vibeke
trainer.svb_route11_b.defeated: You kept the beat. Thanks for the battle.
trainer.svb_route11_b.intro: A song for a battle! Ready?
trainer.svb_route11_b.name: Busker Lauritz
trainer.svb_route12_a.intro: One scoop or two? Battle first!
trainer.svb_route12_a.name: Ice-cream server Nanna
trainer.svb_route12_b.defeated: You picked the win. Take an apple.
trainer.svb_route12_b.intro: The apples can wait. A battle can't!
trainer.svb_route12_b.name: Apple picker Inger
trainer.svb_route13_a.defeated: That deserves a badge… well, this will do.
trainer.svb_route13_a.intro: Always prepared! For a battle too.
trainer.svb_route13_a.name: Scout Nora
trainer.svb_route13_b.defeated: The dog took it better than I did.
trainer.svb_route13_b.intro: We walk every day. Today we battle!
